source_of_rules: docs/IRRIGATION_AGENT_PILOT_REMOTE_SENSING_2026_11_01_EN.md section 2 (16 checks) and docs/IRRIGATION_AGENT_PILOT_PLAN_2026_11_01_EN.md section 4; plan v5 section 3 'Data-fix loop'
principles: Each hit is a question to the owner, never a claimed error.
Geometry, code and area checks (9, 10, 11) and hygiene checks (1, 2, 15, 16) are report-only: never fix proposals.
The only field a proposal may change is type6 (main_class follows). Geometry, cadastral code and area are never edited.
Owner labels win: a parcel with an owner label is reported, never proposed.
Start/stop and two-crop classes of cultivation_change_v2 are on hold and are not read; only the yearly state, the June-October NDVI maximum and the pipeline crop-cycle count are used.
Hits carry an opaque handle, never the cadastral code or the internal parcel id.

width_classes.note: wide = mean width 20 m or more; sliver = under 5 m; strip = between

series.clear_note: a clear date = ndvi_valid_fraction >= 0.8 and NDVI median inside [-1, 1] (the cultivation_change_v2 gate)

AUD01_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: Out of range
AUD01_OUT_OF_RANGE.rule: NDVI or BSI median outside [-1, 1] on any row; NDVI p10/p90 outside [-1, 1] counted separately

AUD02_CLOUD_LEAK_DATE.title: Cloud leak date
AUD02_CLOUD_LEAK_DATE.rule: on clear dates: NDVI at least drop_min below the previous clear date, and back to within recover_within of that previous value on a clear date within recover_days; a date is flagged when at least min_parcels parcels dip on it

AUD03_NO_CROP_CULTIVATED.title: No-crop land cropped
AUD03_NO_CROP_CULTIVATED.rule: type NO_CROP and the 2025 yearly state is cultivated

AUD04_NON_FARM_CULTIVATED.title: Not farmland cropped
AUD04_NON_FARM_CULTIVATED.rule: type NON_FARM and cultivated in at least min_years of the years; strips (under 20 m) are report-only because of road-edge mixing

AUD05_FIELD_CROP_NEVER_CULTIVATED.title: Field crop never cultivated
AUD05_FIELD_CROP_NEVER_CULTIVATED.rule: type FIELD_CROP, no cultivated year in the years, and at least min_idle_years idle years

AUD06_PERENNIAL_NO_GREEN.title: Perennial, no green season
AUD06_PERENNIAL_NO_GREEN.rule: perennial type (ORCHARD, VINEYARD, PERENNIAL) and June-October NDVI maximum under max_ndvi in every listed year
AUD06_PERENNIAL_NO_GREEN.note: review only: such tests missed 15 of 30 confirmed perennials, so no type is suggested

AUD07_PERENNIAL_CROP_CYCLES.title: Perennial with crop cycles
AUD07_PERENNIAL_CROP_CYCLES.rule: perennial type and at least one pipeline crop cycle in at least min_years of the years

AUD08_GREENHOUSE_FIELD_CURVE.title: Greenhouse, field-like curve
AUD08_GREENHOUSE_FIELD_CURVE.rule: type GREENHOUSE and at least one pipeline crop cycle in any of the years

AUD09_SLIVER.title: Slivers
AUD09_SLIVER.rule: area under min_area_ha or mean width under min_width_m

AUD10_DUPLICATE_NESTED.title: Duplicate / nested geometry
AUD10_DUPLICATE_NESTED.rule: identical geometry, or overlap above nested_share of the smaller parcel; overlaps above overlap_report_m2 counted separately (1 m2 overlaps are routine)

AUD11_AREA_MISMATCH.title: Area mismatch
AUD11_AREA_MISMATCH.rule: geometry area vs official area differ by more than max_rel_diff of the official area

AUD12_EDGE_INTERIOR.title: Edge vs interior
AUD12_EDGE_INTERIOR.rule: on clear dates with inner-pixel valid fraction >= inner_valid_min: interior NDVI differs from the parcel median by more than max_diff on at least min_dates dates

AUD13_STRESS_ON_NON_FARM.title: Stress on non-farm land
AUD13_STRESS_ON_NON_FARM.rule: irrigation stress v2 candidate on a parcel typed NON_FARM or not classifiable

AUD14_TYPE_VS_TRANSITIONS_V3.title: Type vs old pipeline
AUD14_TYPE_VS_TRANSITIONS_V3.rule: type VINEYARD or ORCHARD that Transitions v3 calls annual

AUD15_STALE_THIN_SERIES.title: Stale / thin series
AUD15_STALE_THIN_SERIES.rule: latest year: last clear date more than stale_days before the series end; fewer than thin_min_dates clear dates in the window; a gap of more than max_gap_days between clear dates in the window

AUD16_WEATHER_GAPS.title: Weather gaps
AUD16_WEATHER_GAPS.rule: ERA5 daily store: missing or incomplete days, negative rain, ET0 above max_et0 mm/day, in the window of each year up to the last stored day
